_comment: Every built place in the Ashen Vale, read by scripts/systems/sites/site_registry.gd. FIXED sites are instanced directly in scenes/levels/vale.tscn and listed here only so grass, trees and scattered props keep off their walls and floors (tests/test_sites.gd checks position, height and layout agree with the scene). Houses live in vale_houses.json and points of interest in vale_pois.json; Settlements builds those at run time. Schema per site: id (unique in the area), layout (a data/structures/ layout), at [x, z] world metres, yaw degrees, and for fixed sites y. See docs/WORLD_PLAN.md.
